name: XmlNamespaces
description: Represents the collection of XmlNamespace objects in a workbook.
remarks: Use the Item method to access a particular XmlNamespace object. Use the Value property to return a String that lists the namespaces that have been added to a workbook.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the XML namespaces that have been added to the workbook.

methods.name: InstallManifest
methods.description: Installs the specified XML expansion pack on the user's computer, making an XML smart document solution available to one or more users.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path and file name of the XML expansion pack.

parameters.name: InstallForAllUsers
parameters.description: True installs the XML expansion pack and makes it available to all users on a machine. False makes the XML expansion pack available for the current user only. The default is False.
